chrome-devtools.description: Inspect and audit web pages in Chrome: accessibility tree, Lighthouse accessibility and performance audits, traces, console, screenshots

github.description: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests and CI; uses the gh CLI login

sentry.description: Errors and performance issues users hit (Sentry, OAuth sign-in)

linear.description: Linear tickets, projects and comments (OAuth sign-in)

slack.description: Slack conversations and messages (OAuth sign-in; your workspace may require its own Slack app client ID)

figma.description: Figma design files: frames, components, comments (OAuth sign-in)

posthog.description: PostHog product analytics: trends, funnels, retention, replays (OAuth sign-in)

mixpanel.description: Mixpanel product analytics, US region (OAuth sign-in)

amplitude.description: Amplitude product analytics, US region (OAuth sign-in)

clarity.description: Microsoft Clarity heatmaps and session recordings; needs CLARITY_API_TOKEN

dovetail.description: Dovetail research library: projects, highlights, insights; needs DOVETAIL_API_TOKEN

intercom.description: Intercom support conversations, contacts and help articles, US region (OAuth sign-in)

software.name: gh
software.purpose: GitHub PRs, reviews, CI; also signs in the github connector
software.install: https://cli.github.com (macOS: brew install gh), then gh auth login

software.name: agent-browser
software.install: npm install -g agent-browser && agent-browser install (pi-agent-browser also offers this on first use)
